title: Project Manager Job at BlueChip Technologies
content:
BlueChip Technologies is a leading business application firm focused exclusively on assisting organizations in planning, designing, implementing and operating business application solutions and strategies that are central to creating and maintaining a competitive business advantage.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Project Manager

Job Location: Lagos (Hybrid)
Job Type: Contract

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Coordinate internal resources and third-party vendors for seamless project execution
	Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget
	Develop detailed project plans and ensure stakeholder alignment
	Ensure resource availability and effective allocation
	Manage project scope, schedule, and cost changes using appropriate techniques
	Track and measure project performance using relevant tools and methodologies
	Perform proactive risk and escalation management
	Maintain strong stakeholder and client relationships
	Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation
	Plan, execute, monitor, and successfully close projects


Qualifications


	Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, IT, Economics, Statistics, or a related field
	Minimum of 4 years’ of experience post NYSC as an IT Project Manager.
	PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is required


Key Skills Required:
Leadership:


	Ability to lead, motivate, and drive high-performing teams
	Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills


Communication:


	Excellent verbal and written communication skills
	Ability to engage stakeholders across all levels


Organizational Skills:


	Strong time management and multitasking abilities
	Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously


Negotiation & Conflict Resolution:


	Skilled in managing stakeholder expectations and resolving conflicts
	Professional and diplomatic in handling sensitive issues


Technical Skills:


	Strong knowledge of Agile and Waterfall methodologies
	Familiarity with tools such as Microsoft Project and other PM tools


Budgeting & Financial Management:


	Ability to manage budgets and control project costs effectively


Risk & Quality Management:


	Strong risk identification and mitigation skills
	Ability to ensure deliverables meet defined quality standards.


Benefits & Perks


	Competitive salary package
	Health, dental, and vision coverage
	Retirement savings plan with company contributions
	Professional development opportunities
	Flexible work environment
	Inclusive and innovative workplace culture.
    

    

        Click here to Apply

Graphic Designer Job at Astria Learning




        
    

        
        Astria Learning is an edtech company that partners with universities and institutions to deliver digital learning solutions — from online program development and learning management platforms to digital libraries and student enrollment services. Our mission is to help institutions expand access to quality education at scale.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Graphic Designer (Nigeria)

Job Location: Nigeria

Description
     

            
    




	Astria Learning is looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our Marketing team.
	In this role, you will craft compelling visual assets that reinforce our brand identity across digital and print channels — from social media campaigns and partner collateral to event signage and email graphics.
	You will work closely with marketing stakeholders and business partners to translate briefs into polished, on-brand design work delivered on time and to specification.


What you'll do


	Design digital marketing assets including social media creatives, ad banners, email visuals, landing page graphics, and campaign toolkits.
	Produce partner and sales collateral such as presentations, one-pagers, brochures, flyers, posters, and branded templates.
	Prepare print-ready materials for events and expos — banners, roll-ups, signage, and handouts — with correct specifications (bleed, formats, and exports).
	Maintain consistent brand application across all outputs: colors, typography, layout, and logo usage.
	Support basic visual updates for website and eCommerce properties (banners, section graphics, product visuals) as needed.
	Organize and manage design files, templates, and brand assets to ensure easy reuse and version control.
	Collaborate with marketing teammates and stakeholders to interpret briefs, present concepts, incorporate feedback, and meet deadlines.


What we're looking for


	Bachelor's Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field or equivalent professional experience.
	3 - 5 years of professional graphic design experience, ideally within a marketing or brand environment.
	Strong proficiency in Canva and the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
	Good working knowledge of Figma for shared assets and collaborative templates.
	Solid grounding in branding principles, typography, composition, and visual storytelling.
	Demonstrated experience producing both digital and print deliverables, including pre-press and export standards.
	Strong communication skills, high attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.


Nice to have:


	Basic motion graphics skills — simple animations for social media or digital advertising.
	Familiarity with WordPress or Shopify environments when coordinating implementation of visual assets with development teams.
